Commentary.Commentary: THE MATCH HAS BEEN ABANDONED. New place, new day but the result is the same as the previous game. This is the third match in this World Cup that has been abandoned. At least we had some overs on Monday but today we did not even get to see the toss and for the second game in a row, the teams will share the points. Sri Lanka will have to be happy with just one point. Bangladesh's losing run of 2 games comes to an end but they would have come here looking to end it with a win though now they will head into the next fixture with a washed out game behind them. So that's it from this game. End of another sorry day for all the cricket lovers. We will be back on 12th June though, as Australia take on Pakistan in Taunton. That game will begin at 1030 Local (0930 GMT). Let's hope we do not get a hat-trick of washouts and finally get a game on that one. Till then, cheers!
